Written by Lisa Wu, Sales Manager & Packaging Project AdvisorPublished July 24, 2026Reviewed August 13, 2026

Lisa coordinates B2B packaging specifications, quotations, sampling and production communication with the BestPackFactory team.

Quick Answer for Sourcing

B2B buyers should choose Mylar bags with multi-layer laminate structures (PET/VMPET/PE) to ensure low OTR (Oxygen Transmission Rate) and WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate). High barrier properties are essential for food, supplements, and cannabis products.

Key Buyer Checklist

  • Verify MOQ and material specifications.
  • Confirm dieline and artwork requirements.
  • Request lead time for production and shipping.
  • Validate barrier properties (for flexible packaging).

Barrier and seal verification method

Method for Mylar Bags Barrier Materials: The Ultimate RFQ Checklist: Specify the final laminate, specimen count, conditioning, temperature and humidity, test method, equipment, units and acceptance limits before comparing barrier or seal results.

  • ISO 2528:2017 specifies a gravimetric method for water-vapour transmission rate and states important sensitivity and material limits for that method.
  • ASTM F88/F88M-23 measures flexible-barrier seal strength and requires the support technique to remain consistent within a test series.

Evidence limit: A material name or generic target is not a batch result. Buyers should require a report for the final printed laminate that identifies the method, conditions, specimen preparation, results and acceptance limit.

What the Spec Means for Buyers

A mylar bag RFQ must lock three specs: structure, barrier and closure. Structure is PET 12µm / AL 7µm / PE 80µm for full foil or MOPP 20µm / VMPET 12µm / PE 80µm for metalized; smell-proof foil targets OTR ≤ 0.5 cc/m²·day and WVTR ≤ 0.5 g/m²·day. Closure is a double-lock child-resistant zipper (ASTM D3475-style) or press-to-close zipper at 7–10 mm; seal strength ≥ 35 N / 15 mm with top seal width 8–10 mm. Include artwork requirements (vector logo, 3 mm bleed), color tolerance ΔE ≤ 3.0, and the reserved compliance area for warning icon, batch code, THC/CBD content and QR panel.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the smell-proof barrier target?

A foil mylar structure is specified at OTR ≤ 0.5 cc/m²·day and WVTR ≤ 0.5 g/m²·day.

What closure is standard for mylar bags?

A double-lock child-resistant zipper (ASTM D3475-style) or press-to-close zipper of 7–10 mm width.
